import math

# Data for Rural Electrification Administration (1961-1970)
values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")

# Calculate Theil index
# T = (1/n) * Σ ((x_i / μ) * ln(x_i / μ))
theil_sum = 0
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"\nTheil index of dispersion: {theil_index}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(theil_index, 3)}")
EOF

print(f"n: {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

    ratio = v / mean
    term = ratio * math.log(ratio)
    print(f"  {v}: {ratio:.6f} * ln({ratio:.6f}) = {ratio:.6f} * {math.log(ratio):.6f} = {term:.6f}")

print(f"\nSum of terms: {theil_sum}")
